content.short: Pawnfi appraises and liquidates non-standard assets (NSAs) such as LP tokens and NFTs.
content.description: Pawnfi evaluates and liquidates non-standard assets (NSAs), including LP tokens, smaller cryptocurrencies, and NFTs. Its workflow is governed by smart contract escrow and settlement, ensuring transparent, trustless transactions. The platform employs a crowd-lending model for assets with slower turnover and offers pool lending for assets that turnover more quickly. It also integrates floor and ceiling price data to establish the true value range of each NSA.
